intro_line: Portuguese tiles, neon casinos, and sea breezes meet at the edge of China.
intro: Macau rewards visitors with a compact UNESCO-listed historic centre, Portuguese colonial churches, and some of the best Cantonese and Macanese food in the region. Its casino resorts, waterfront trails, and easy day trips add variety to every visit. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
transit_facts: Light Rail (LRT) Taipa Line links Taipa, Cotai, and the Barra area. Check locally for current routes.
Buses cover the peninsula and islands. Pay with a Macau Pass card or exact cash coins. Check locally for fares.
Taxis are plentiful and cheap. Ask for the meter. Ride-hailing apps have limited availability, so check locally.
Driving is not recommended. Roads are congested and parking is scarce and costly.
The historic centre is best explored on foot. Taipa and Coloane suit cycling and shuttle buses.
Ferries run from Outer Harbour and Taipa to Hong Kong, Shenzhen, and Zhuhai, so you can plan day trips by boat.

airports.note: Main airport in Taipa, about 7 km from the centre.
